svg.title: Glyphcss trend line in a conversation
svg.desc:
A chat: the user asks for a trend line, the agent loads the glyphcss-diagrams skill, and the reply is the actual braille chart from the bundled renderer. Example data.
Weekly signups
Signups
50 ┤ ⢀⡠⢄⣀ │ ⢀⡠⠒⠁ ⠉⠑⠒⠤ │ ⢠⠒⠁ │ ⢠⠃ 40 ┤ ⢠⠃ │ ⢠⠃ │ ⢠⠃ 30 ┤ ⡠⢄⣀⡀ ⢠⠃ │ ⡰⠁ ⠈⠉⠒⠒⠤⠃ │ ⡜ │ ⡠⣀ ⢀⠎ 20 ┤ ⡠⠊ ⠑⠢⣀ ⢠⠊ │ ⡠⠊ ⠑⠢⠃ └⠠⠊────┬───────────┬────────────┬───────────┬ 2 4 6 8 Week
